items.title: CAS set for a rework: What's up for change
items.description: India's securities regulator is reviewing its new closing auction framework.  This review follows initial implementation challenges and market participant concerns.  Sebi proposes changes to derivatives settlement and market timings.  Order cancellation rules are also being tightened to prevent price manipulation.  These adjustments aim to improve the robustness of closing price discovery.

items.title: Stock Market Holiday today: NSE, BSE to remain shut for Ganesh Chaturthi. Check upcoming market holidays
items.description: India's largest commodity exchange, the Multi-Commodity Exchange of India (MCX), will remain closed for the first session (9 am to 5 pm) on Monday. Trading will resume in the evening session between 5 pm and 11:30 pm, as per its website. The National Commodity & Derivatives Exchange (NCDEX), meanwhile, will remain closed for the entire day.

items.title: Gujarat surges ahead of UP in new investor additions, adds 2.3L in August
items.description: Gujarat led the charge in new investor registrations in August, surpassing all other states. It was trailed by Uttar Pradesh and Maharashtra, which also showcased impressive growth in investor numbers both on a monthly and yearly basis. Remarkably, West India spearheaded the rebound in new investor activity, with North India maintaining the largest share of new investors at the national level.

items.title: SP Group weighs Rs 3,500 crore debt repayment options
items.description: Shapoorji Pallonji Group is exploring debt options for a ₹3,500 crore repayment.  The central bank's Tata Sons listing mandate offers investors a clear repayment path.  This directive will build investor confidence in monetizing Tata group stakes.  It also assures future redemption commitments for the conglomerate.  The group seeks to manage its financial obligations effectively.

items.title: HDFC CEO race: One insider, one outsider in contention for the top job
items.description: HDFC Bank has nominated Kaizad Bharucha and an external candidate for the top leadership role. The bank seeks a six-month tenure rule relaxation for Bharucha to complete a full term. Anup Bagchi and K Balasubramanian were strong external contenders for the position. Bharucha offers continuity during the bank's ongoing integration and leadership transition. The external candidate was chosen for experience handling significant business scale and complexity.

items.title: Jefferies says Sebi's proposed CAS changes will remove uncertainty, but still remains negative on BSE. Here’s why
items.description: Jefferies expects Sebi’s proposed CAS changes to reduce expiry-day volatility and uncertainty but remains negative on BSE shares, citing limited options-industry growth, a ceiling in market-share gains, tighter bank guarantee norms and a potential management transition. The brokerage prefers Groww, citing strong earnings growth levers and recovery in F&O activity.

items.title: FIIs sell Indian shares worth Rs 14,475 crore in Sept; analyst warns soaring bond yields may deepen selloff
items.description: Foreign investors sold Indian equities worth Rs 14,475 crore in September as oil prices and global bond yields surged amid escalating Middle East tensions. Analysts warned that further rises in US Treasury yields could intensify FPI outflows and pressure equities.

items.title: HDFC Bank shares hit 52-week lows over consecutive sessions while analysts scream Buy. Has the stock hit its bottom?
items.description: HDFC Bank shares have hit fresh 52-week lows despite continued ‘Buy’ calls from brokerages. Analysts cite attractive valuations and potential margin improvement, while technical indicators remain weak, raising questions over whether the stock has bottomed.

items.title: India beats a hasty retreat from a crucial market reform
items.description: India’s market-closing auction reform, designed by Sebi to curb price manipulation, has faced volatility and investor backlash within weeks. The regulator may weaken or abandon it, exposing deeper problems: high securities taxes, inadequate arbitrage, shallow liquidity and restrictions on short selling. Poor coordination between fiscal and regulatory policies ultimately undermined reform efforts.

items.title: 20 midcap funds, 20 multibaggers: What makes this category a wealth creation machine?
items.description: Midcap mutual funds have delivered exceptional wealth creation over the past decade, with all 20 schemes boasting a full 10-year track record emerging as multibaggers. But can the category repeat that performance? Experts point to strong earnings growth and structural opportunities, while warning that elevated valuations, volatility, crowded trades and a limited stock universe could constrain future returns.

items.title: Why can’t NSE trade on its own platform after the IPO, and is it a big deal?
items.description: NSE MD Ashish Chauhan clarified that the exchange will not seek Sebi approval to list or trade its shares on its own platform. Under Sebi rules, a recognised exchange can list only on another exchange, meaning NSE’s upcoming IPO is expected to result in a BSE-only listing.

items.title: Top Nifty50 stocks analysts suggest buying in this volatile week
items.description: Stock Reports Plus, powered by Refinitiv, is a comprehensive report that evaluates five key components of 4,000+ listed stocks – earnings, fundamentals, relative valuation, risk, and price momentum – to generate standardised scores. The simple average of the above-mentioned five component ratings is normally distributed to reach an average score.

items.title: Macquarie completes Maple InvIT stake buyout
items.description: Following the transaction, MAM and La Caisse will jointly hold controlling stakes in Maple’s investment manager and project manager.

items.title: Oversold Nifty could see a short-term rebound: Analysts
items.description: Indian stock indices, Sensex and Nifty, have extended their losing streak for a fifth week. Analysts suggest the indices have entered oversold territory, indicating a potential short-term rebound. Traders are advised to consider specific strategies like a Bull Put Spread for the September 29, 2026 expiry. Several top stocks, including Kotak Mahindra Bank and BHEL, are recommended for buying with defined targets.
